additional_info.subject: ID0380407-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / P8 312547889/13] Failsafe mode active CRM:00642001532
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing great.
As per reported issue, charger is in failsafe mode
Upon our own investigation, we have confirmed that the charger is indeed offline on the SCB system.
Unfortunately, there's not much that can be done remotely without an SCB connection. It would be best to have someone on-site to perform a check.
Performing local reboots can restore the charger to working condition.
If the router is connected to internet
If the charger is powered
Please consider the following points that may cause the charger to trip the SCB.
There may be an internet issue with the Siemens router, likely due to the failover function causing the WAN to switch from Cellular to Ethernet.
I suggest performing a Hard reset through "OCPP" if the charger is connected to an OCPP server, or a local reboot to restore functionality.
The data service of a mobile network operator may be unavailable.
- SIM card disabled / expired
- Monthly data volume exhausted
- Signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions
- In case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
Backend related issues
- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger
- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
Teltonika related issues
- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)
- Hardware failure of Router
- Router software crash
I hope this will resolve the issue.
If you require our assistance for on-site intervention, please inform us at least one week in advance.
Additionally, as per the reported issue, the failsafe mode has been activated in this charger. Please refer to the Knowledge article below for your reference.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_PLC,SECC_Failsafe mode error - Dynamics 365
